surfaces.label: Administrator session termination
surfaces.notes: Copied tokens remain valid after logout; auth helper and export sink reviewed.

surfaces.label: Customer authentication and ownership
surfaces.notes: getUser verified identity, confirmation guard, PKCE flow cookies, server ownership and public DTOs reviewed. 17 SDK contract tests; deployed Confirm Email required.

surfaces.label: PostgreSQL RLS and commerce transactions
surfaces.notes: All 19 application tables and SQL RPCs reviewed. 46 real PostgreSQL tests cover A/B/anon, denial of privileged writes/functions, price forgery, inventory/payment/refund idempotence and v4→v5 migration.

surfaces.label: Webhook cryptography and interrupted work
surfaces.notes: Real Stripe signatures/timestamp/mode verified locally; busy503 and completed200 via actual PostgreSQL claims; source correspondence reviewed.

surfaces.label: Browser serialization, uploads and private documents
surfaces.notes: All first-party app/components/hooks/lib/data/types TS/TSX source reviewed in baseline plus final independent pass. JSON-LD escaped; uploads bounded; private attachments sandboxed.

surfaces.label: Newsletter consent and queue durability
surfaces.notes: Consent rechecked before queued campaign sends; fail closed lookup; compatible upsert unique index. HTTP contract tests, not actual Resend delivery.

surfaces.label: Deployment and platform settings
surfaces.notes: Supabase/Stripe/Resend credentials absent locally, no cloud RLS/Auth/Storage or live commerce verification. Direct Auth abuse controls and database privileged-role attribution must be reviewed in staging.

surfaces.label: Dependency and agent environment
surfaces.notes: npm audit0 known advisories; AgentShield triaged. Host Guard inactive and mutable MCP package outside repository scope documented separately.
